description: Step 1 of connecting a restaurant's own domain to its Chopflow menu: the TXT records Cloudflare checks before it issues the certificate. The CNAME is a separate template (chopflow.io.storefront), applied once the certificate is ready, so a site already on www is never switched before it can be served.
variableDescription: cfOwnership: Cloudflare's ownership token for the hostname. cfCertificate1 and cfCertificate2: Cloudflare's certificate validation tokens (opaque values issued per hostname; a second one is not always issued, in which case its group is not applied).
